objective: First scale implementation: record measured provider usage and hold narrowly confirmed terminal Instagram source failures for user verdict without pausing unrelated videos. Default disabled for source holds. Preserve claims, audit, full conservative coverage and every other global gate. Reviewable code only; distributed ledger and full3005 admission remain next phase.
acceptance_criteria: Measure supported global Gemini3.5FlashLite standard responses from usageMetadata including cache and reasoning
Measure standard Chirp3/us sync and single-file async STT using totalBilledDuration; never sum duplicated file/global values or replace missing duration by video length
Missing/unsupported/malformed measurement produces an explicit unavailable record, not zero cost or a pipeline failure
Persist measurement in existing immutable artifacts with model/rate/source provenance; no extra provider calls, storage objects, ledger settlement or budget changes
Offline CLI aggregates measurements and reports coverage/unavailable cases without reading credentials, calling APIs or mutating input files
Preserve raw response, output validation and stage idempotency; verify cache/thoughts, no-speech, batch duplication and unknown metadata
Source auto-hold is opt-in, batch262 only, upload stage after payment claim, media absence verified, metadata/format-selection terminal diagnoses only; do not retry or assert source private/deleted
HTTP403/429, login, network, timeout, local IO, media-transfer failure, missing proof or failed reconciliation still use existing global pause
Persist case/audit/claim proof before financial coverage completes; keep failed worker claim uncertain and preserve global pause if another operation triggered it
Free only the held source lease after full maximum accounting and recorded verdict, with no inference or source replay

context.reason: Persist measurement and verify source media absence
Catch known terminal source failure before existing global uncertain pause
Full conservative source accounting without toggling global controls

review.reason: Independent human review before deploy or source-hold activation; opt-in conservative source settlement changes require review, all other financial gates retained, no extra model executions.
